summary: Who may act (lens ours): account profiles, MCP/CLI client grants, guardian consent, processing authorizations, policy versions, source restrictions.

The only surface apps and agents see; invoker views and definer RPCs organised as the L1–L3 knowledge continuum.
What we author (lens ours): immutable revisions of courses, modules, lessons, activities, briefs, reports and datasets; releases freeze closures for distribution.
Faithful documents decomposed into typed units with stable logical keys; census before kind, digests anchored to units, refresh as data.
Structure, outcomes and requirements of authored course works, keyed to authoring revisions (machinery lens: written by product operations).
Datasets, graders, review tasks, and verification benchmarks (machinery lens).
Source to capture to locator to claim; facts attach through segment_support; verified use is admitted in verification.use_admission.
Typed expert knowledge items (problem, pattern, failure mode, constraint, practice, example, security, usage) bound to entities, created only with a receipt.
One canonical row per industry identity; kind-specific attributes are a validated jsonb, not typed tables.
Build 07 research loop (lens ours): a brief is accepted with obligations, outputs are delivered, assertions carry typed support, datasets are revisioned cells.
Durable KS operations, steps, outbox, and eve bindings (machinery lens).
What learners do (lens ours): enroll in an offer, adopt a release, attempt activities, submit evidence, get graded, appeal, earn credit.

Traces, spans, and normalized runtime events, month-partitioned (machinery lens).
Missions, intents, immutable receipts, and content-addressed artifacts (machinery lens).
The product's command/read/worker dispatchers; every `when '<op>' then` arm has a page under ops/.

A leaderboard is a named ranked view over fact segments; editions freeze membership at a knowledge head. Benchmark versions are in `api.benchmarks`; `api.leaderboard_diff(slug, edition_a, edition_b)` shows what entered, left or moved between two captures of a leaderboard.
One relationship table; kinds constrain endpoints and may carry a relationship_active stream.
One retrieval stack: every searchable text is a vector item with lens, source tier and facets; api.search_unified scopes then fuses.
Candidates for new identities, not a staging copy of facts.
A fact is a segment on a stream with a world interval and a knowledge interval; one home for every number.
L2: advisories affecting a software thing, and whether a given version falls in each vulnerable range (numeric component comparison, not string compare: 1.2.3 < 1.2.14).

The contract a Mission Control watch mission calls: which attention policies are due at a time, because a trigger event happened since the last non-backfill sweep inside the trigger window (a trigger with "only": "major" counts x.0.0 releases only), or because the cadence elapsed since any sweep. W0 and paused policies are never due.
L2 both clocks: facts opened/replaced, events and unit changes learned after p_since; format-only unit changes (same content, different representation format) are excluded (§14.7 fix a).

Executor decision that a proposal becomes a canonical fact through the temporal helpers. A verified claim's receipt must name an admitted use decision, recorded in verification.use_admission by verification.assert_admitted_use in the same transaction. Distinct from receipt outcome applied and from plan outcomes such as review_required or held.

A typed alternate name (synonym, acronym, former_name, handle, ticker, slug, misspelling, translation, model_alias). Unique per (entity, normalized alias, alias_kind), not globally unique across entities.
Content-addressed stored object (sha256, bucket_class, storage_bucket, object_path) typed by artifact_type. Lineage edges record derived_from, supersedes, corrects, produced_by, consumed_by.

content.unit_assertion_mapping declares how a unit kind's attributes become an assertion (a stream kind, relationship, event or attribute) with subject, value, qualifier and time templates. Deterministic mappings on first-party structured units take the cheap path; others carry a risk floor and go through Knowledge Services verification. evidence.extraction_record records which mapping interpreted which unit.
How strongly a guidance item or vector item is backed. guidance.assurance_level is the vocabulary; retrieval filters accept a minimum assurance rank.
accepted, disputed, or unknown on a segment or occurrence. disputed does not replace an accepted current segment; the executor plans review_required.

One row in catalog.entity. kind picks the taxonomy.entity_kind whose attributes_schema validates the row's attributes jsonb. lifecycle is active, merged, or retired. Numbers that change over time are fact streams, never attributes.

content.structure_census records what a captured representation structurally contains (headings, tables, lists, code, timecodes, speakers, figures, machine blocks) before any document kind or grammar is assigned. Kinds are open-world: a document_type can be candidate until its grammar settles, and promotion candidates come from census statistics.
An atomic statement with claim_type, status, and created_by_receipt_id. Facts may cite a claim as primary_claim_id. Subjects are attached via claim_subject roles subject, object, or context.
Catalog hint for statement_timeout and EXPLAIN gates. cheap and medium default to 15s; heavy is 60s and must not sequential-scan large relations.

content.document_digest is a structured digest of a document version (or a section/entity view) whose content.digest_item rows are records anchored to unit node ids — key points, entity roles, assertion references, changes, open questions, limitations, research directions. Prose summaries in content.document_summary render a digest; prose without a digest is not evidence.
A curated map of 5–20 relations that belong together (identity, temporal-facts, content, …). Default domain for a schema is schema_domains; a relation overlay may override it.

taxonomy.entity_kind.code. Carries attributes_schema (validates catalog.entity.attributes), parent_kind (model version -> model; the link itself is a catalog.relationship) and is_work. catalog.entity.kind is a foreign key; unknown kinds cannot be inserted.
A retrieval-assembled bundle of members (verified claims, guidance items, source-faithful representations with scores and locators) for one question. Read with api.evidence_packet.
Source text for a date with precision (instant, day, month, quarter, year, relative, unknown) and optional earliest/latest bounds. Required when temporal_basis is explicit or carry_forward.

acquisition.fetch is one attempt to obtain bytes from a URL — who (origin), with what tool, outcome, hash, spend — recorded before it becomes an evidence.source_capture. outcome unchanged means the same bytes as prior_capture_id, so no new document version; content.refresh_check records that per document.
Digest of schema structure plus vocabularies, or of workspace plus enrichment. Artifacts also carry content sha256. Ingestion intents cite workspaceFingerprint; mismatch is WORKSPACE_STALE.

guidance.item is one expert knowledge statement typed by guidance.item_kind (technical_problem, solution_pattern, failure_mode, compatibility_constraint, operational_practice, implementation_example, security_consideration, advanced_usage_pattern, setup_guide_step, research_direction) with a payload validated by that kind's schema, an assurance level, a provenance claim and the entities it is about (guidance.item_subject). Created only under a receipt.

authoring.work.head_revision_id, the current immutable authoring.work_revision of a course, module, lesson, activity, brief, report or dataset. Commands that change a work pass p_expected_head; a stale head is CONFLICT. api.works_authored lists works at their head.

api.search_unified fuses english full-text, trigram and (when an embedding is given) ANN channels with reciprocal rank fusion over the one stack, filtered by lens, tier, space, document kind, unit kind, entity, as-of and workspace. api.hybrid_knowledge_search_1536 is the older per-space-version entry.

Unique per tenant on operation_intent, knowledge_batch and authoring.command (product operations). A second submit of the same bytes returns the existing receipt or result; the same key with different input is CONFLICT.
A schemed external identifier. scheme is a closed check-constraint vocabulary. Unique per tenant on (scheme, value), so one identifier names at most one entity.
A durable proposed operation. knowledge-read-intent.v1 and knowledge-ingestion-intent.v1 are the workspace contracts; the ledger row is orchestration.operation_intent with an idempotency_key.
One committed admission transaction. commit_batch writes a knowledge_batch row with a receipt, idempotency key, and input digest, then advances the tenant head by one.

The four answer levels every question routes through. L1 catalog tables (api.models, api.software, …) filter, compare and rank without embeddings; L2 facts and time (api.changes_since, api.price_history, api.fact_locators, api.entity_at) answer what was true when and where it was read; L3 scoped semantic search (api.search_unified, api.talk_segments, api.document_units, api.document_digest) finds passages inside a scope; L4 is a budgeted agent loop over L1–L3 that files its result as a report.
Per-tenant monotonic sequence of sealed knowledge batches. Every snapshot and ingestion intent cites it; begin_batch fails rebase_required when the expected head does not match.
When a fact was admitted or closed. Stamped from the open batch. Current rows have k_to null; closed rows keep history. api.changes_since reports learned_at beside world_from.

Whose knowledge a row is. corpus is ingested industry knowledge (catalog, content, temporal, taxonomy, staging, acquisition, ranking, guidance, retrieval, the api catalog views); ours is what we author and learn (authoring, learning, access, library, inquiry, dataset, product, api.works_authored); private is one workspace's passages and conversations (RLS-isolated); evidence is claims, locators and admissions; machinery and legacy are runtime plumbing hidden from START_HERE and MAP. Every search-index entry and page carries a lens; retrieval.vector_item.lens and api.search_unified p_lenses use the same words.

A precise selection inside a capture (text_quote, table cell, media_timecode, page+bbox, JSON pointer, line range) with selected_content_sha256 and a normalized value. Support rows require a locator; api.fact_locators shows the locator, capture and typed unit behind a current fact.

unit_kind plus the values of the kind's logical_key_attributes (for a price_row offering|meter|tier|region), so the same unit can be matched across versions of a document. content.unit_change diffs versions by logical key; api.changes_since reports those diffs beside fact changes.

The thing an offering price is charged per (input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_input_tokens, batch_input_tokens, …). Required in the offering_price payload; with tier and region it forms the price series scope_key, and api.price_history takes it as p_meter.

orchestration.mission is the durable work envelope. Intents, artifacts and acquisition.fetch rows may record mission ids. Mission Control admission is out of band; this workspace only stores the id when supplied.
An entry in the knowledge-query-catalog. Agents pass a name and params; they never send SQL. Build validation executes each example under the catalog role.

One `when '<op>' then` arm of product.dispatch_command / dispatch_read / dispatch_worker / dispatch_research_*, called through api.product_command(workspace, op, idempotency_key, expected_head, payload), api.product_read or api.product_worker. Each has a page under ops/ listing the relations the arm touches.

A derived retrieval object (search_projection, vector_item) pointing at a projection_target (entity card, guidance item, chunk, claim, summary, typed unit, digest, our authored revision or a private passage). retrieval.index_text_item is the one way a text becomes searchable; agents never write embeddings.
A published vector-space version that search is allowed to read. Unpublished or inactive versions raise insufficient_privilege.
Transaction failure (SQLSTATE 40001) from begin_batch when expected head does not match the locked knowledge_head. Not a per-proposal outcome.
Immutable orchestration.operation_receipt for one intent. Outcome is applied, rejected, noop, or partial. Facts and entities require a receipt id before they can be written.
taxonomy.relationship_kind.code with from_kinds, to_kinds, temporal flag, and property_schema. Trigger catalog.check_relationship_kinds rejects illegal endpoints.

Two meanings. authoring.release freezes a root revision's closure for distribution (freeze_release, offer_release); a software release in the corpus is a library_release entity whose release_published event and version facts api.software_releases lists, and api.modules_affected_by_release connects the two.

Enabled on tenant tables. Typical policy km_tenant_access uses tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id(). Private-lens rows (library.passage, conversation.*) are additionally isolated per workspace; api.search_unified returns them only for the workspaces passed in.

NOLOGIN Postgres roles. app_reader sees api views and RPCs. pipeline_agent selects bounded schemas. executor_service alone executes temporal helpers and writes catalog facts. Product operations run as authenticated (api.product_command / api.product_read) or service_role (api.product_worker).

Distinguishes parallel series on the same subject and stream kind (meter|tier|region for prices, episode for engagements). Default is the empty string. Part of the stream unique key; the database enforces no naming convention, so a correction must reuse the existing series key.
One assertion of a fact on a stream. Carries a world interval valid_during and a knowledge interval [k_from, k_to). Current means k_to is null.

A filter and a mild ranking boost, never a truth claim. T0 verified assertions, T1 our own content, T2 primary corpus (first party about itself, filers, registries), T3 third-party corpus, T4 live web. content.source_role.default_source_tier seeds it from who speaks; retrieval.vector_item.source_tier carries it; api.search_unified p_tiers filters on it.
An unresolved proposed identity. Not a staging copy of a fact. Resolution decisions are create, match, reject, or defer; vetting decisions are admit, reject, or defer.
The identity of a fact series, unique on (kind, subject entity or relationship, scope_key). Segments stack on a stream; overlapping current segments are forbidden.

temporal.stream_kind.code with subject_mode, subject_kinds, status_values, unit_values, requires_amount, and payload_schema. commit_batch validates slot rules. offering_price is the one home for prices (payload meter|tier|region), benchmark_score the one home for benchmark numbers.
A k-stamped link from a claim and locator to a segment or event occurrence. Written only through temporal.admit_support inside an open batch.

A question family with navigation, a read or ingestion operation, expected shape, and pitfalls. The shortest path from a natural-language question to a valid catalog query, product operation or intent.
Why the world interval is believed. explicit and carry_forward require an extent; observation_bounded is “true at capture time”; unresolved is an admitted gap.
Isolation key read from GUC app.tenant_id by util.current_tenant_id(). Missing context fails closed. RLS policies compare tenant_id to that function.
World time and knowledge time together. entity.at(entity, T, K) answers what was true at T as we knew it at K; price_history shows every belief with both clocks.

A content.document_node with a unit_kind from the content.unit_kind grammar (price_row, transcript_segment, release_entry, table_row, slide, section, …), attributes validated by that kind's JSON Schema, a logical_key stable across captures and a typed position (offsets, page, bbox, timecodes). Units are the anchors for locators, entity roles, extraction records and retrieval items; chunks are derived from units, never the other way round.

A named retrieval space (units, digests, entity_cards, assertions, own_content, learner_notes, knowledge_text, …) with versions and publications. api.search_unified takes space slugs as a facet; agents read only published versions.

A knowledge_verification component run that must be sealed before cited claims may be materialized; the database records the admitted use in verification.use_admission and a verified claim names an admission-bound receipt.

Allowlisted code tables such as taxonomy.entity_kind, taxonomy.relationship_kind, temporal.stream_kind, content.document_type, content.unit_kind, content.format, content.source_role and guidance.item_kind. Slot rules and endpoint kinds are enforced at write time.

catalog.work is the bibliographic row behind an entity whose kind is a work (paper, talk, media work, story, case study; taxonomy.entity_kind.is_work). Its content lives in content.document rows that point back through work_entity_id.

Generated projection of schema-ir.v1 into Markdown layers, search indexes, operation pages and the named-query catalog. Agents search then read a domain or task page; they never read schema-ir.json whole. Not to be confused with authoring.workspace, the product's team container.
When the world was like this. Stored as a tstzrange bounded below with [) bounds. Distinct from when we came to know it.
